}}'''Aliane Senican''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|332}}.

==History==
Aliane held the position for twenty-three years until her death in {{Ne|355}}. She was [[Doniella Alievin]]'s successor and [[Suilin Escanda]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Aliane began as a strong Amyrlin, but her notions of running things according only to logic (and her rages when others failed to see her logic) led by {{ne|339}} to her becoming not so much a puppet of the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] as ignored by them except when she had to be trotted out for ceremonies.
